instruction: Set Verdana as the default list font in LibreOffice Writer

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting Verdana as the default list font in LibreOffice Writer. The evaluator reads the registrymodifications.xcu file to verify the List font name under DefaultFont settings.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts default list font from LibreOffice registrymodifications.xcu file using proper XML path (/org.openoffice.Office.Writer/DefaultFont -> List property) and namespace handling
Metric correctly handles expected parameter when type='rule': directly accesses expected.get('list_font') since framework passes rules dict directly (not {'type': 'rule', 'rules': {...}})
Metric correctly compares font name using exact string match, which is appropriate for font names
Expected value 'Verdana' correctly matches the instruction requirement
Complete coverage: instruction has single requirement (set Verdana as default list font) and evaluator verifies it
Postconfig includes 'close_all_libreoffice' which forces LibreOffice to persist settings to registrymodifications.xcu before evaluation - correct approach for ensuring state freshness
Error handling present: getter returns None if file not found or parsing fails, metric correctly handles None result by returning 0.0
